systems.system: Child national ID card proposal (بطاقة رقم قومي للأطفال)
systems.owner: Member of the House of Representatives Mai Karam Gabr (proposer); Tansiqiya workshops

note: Reports workshops on an MP's proposal for a child ID card needing amendment of Child Law 12 of 1996; it does not name or date the law setting up Egypt's identity number, register or card, so no fact.
